# Background {#sec-background}

Niue has not licensed any foreign fishing vessels for the past six years, resulting in no offshore catch to
report for 2025. Domestic artisanal fishers continue to supply restaurants, families, and local markets,
though at an inconsistent rate. Reduced annual catches have at times made it diffcult to maintain reliable
supply for food security. Shark depredation has also contributed to the decline, significantly impacting
fishers’ gear and morale.

As tourism grows, marine activities have diversified accordingly. Niue Fisheries is working with the Niue
Ocean Wide (NOW) project to establish management arrangements for Niue’s newest and largest marine
protected area. The MPA will cover significant inshore and offshore habitats and species, as well as
fishing and non-fishing activities. Catch-and-release sport fisheries may be permitted within the area
under licence.
